empty.title: No scenarios yet
empty.description: Training scenarios will appear here as soon as they are published.

noResults.title: No scenarios match these filters
noResults.description: Try another protocol or level, or clear the filters.

how.decide: Each stage describes a moment in the situation. Choose what you would do.
how.kinds: Some stages have one right answer; others ask you to choose all that apply.
how.final: Your answer is final once you confirm it, just as a real action cannot be undone.
how.saved: Your progress is saved after each stage, so you can leave and continue later.
how.result: At the end you see your score, your risk level and the reason behind every choice.

noStages.title: This scenario has no stages yet
noStages.description: Choose another scenario from the catalogue.

stage.label: Stage {current} of {total}
stage.final: Your answer is final once you confirm it.

restart.title: Start this scenario over?
restart.description: A new attempt starts from the first stage. Your answers so far stay in your history as an unfinished attempt.

ready.title: All stages answered
ready.description: Submit to see your score and the explanation of every choice.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.stale: This attempt changed in another tab or window, so the page has been updated.
errors.notFound: This attempt is no longer available.
errors.invalid: That answer could not be accepted. Please choose again.
errors.rateLimited: You have started many attempts in the last hour. Please try again later.
errors.noStages: This scenario has no stages yet.
errors.notPlayable: This scenario is no longer available to you, so this attempt cannot be finished. Your answers so far are kept.
errors.otherInstitution: This attempt counts for an institution that is not your active one, so it cannot be continued here. Your answers so far are kept, and it continues when that institution is your active one again.
errors.scenarioGone: This scenario is no longer available to you. It may have been unpublished or replaced by a new version.

summary.label: Attempt summary
summary.notAssessable: No stage of this scenario is linked to a protocol step, so there is no score or risk level.

riskHint.high: A critical step was broken, or the score is below 50%.
riskHint.mandatory: A mandatory step was not followed. That means at least a medium risk, whatever the score.
riskHint.belowEighty: No mandatory step was missed, but the score is below 80%.
riskHint.medium: A mandatory step was not followed, or the score is below 80%.
riskHint.gaps: No critical or mandatory step was missed and the score is 80% or more, but some steps can still improve.
riskHint.clean: Every protocol step this scenario checks was followed.

critical.title: Critical mistake
critical.description: Breaking a critical step always means a high risk, whatever the score. Critical steps broken in this attempt:

debrief.title: Personal summary
debrief.description: A short summary of this attempt, written by AI from its results.
debrief.failed: The summary could not be written right now. Your results and recommendations do not depend on it.
debrief.aiNote: Written by AI from the results of this attempt. Always check it against the protocol.
debrief.notRequested: The trainee has not asked for a personal summary of this attempt.
debrief.otherInstitution: A personal summary of an attempt made in an institution can be written only while that institution is your active one.
debrief.notAssessable: A personal summary needs a scored attempt.

recommendations.title: What to work on
recommendations.description: Steps to improve, most important first.
recommendations.empty: Nothing to improve here: every step this scenario checks was followed.

strengths.title: What you did well
strengths.description: Protocol steps you handled correctly in this attempt.
strengths.descriptionStaff: Protocol steps the trainee handled correctly in this attempt.
strengths.empty: No step was handled fully correctly this time. The review below shows what to change.

review.title: Stage-by-stage review
review.description: Every option, with the reason it is right or wrong.

status.inProgressTitle: This attempt is not finished yet
status.inProgressDescription: Continue the scenario to see the result.
status.inProgressDescriptionStaff: The result appears here once the trainee finishes the scenario.
status.unavailableDescription: This scenario is not available at the moment, so this attempt cannot be continued.
status.otherInstitutionDescription: This attempt was started in another institution, so it can be continued only while that institution is your active one.
status.otherOpenDescription: An unfinished attempt of this scenario for your active institution comes first here. This one can be continued after that attempt is finished, or from your individual account.
status.abandonedDescription: It was closed before the last stage: a new attempt of the scenario was started, or the scenario was replaced by a new version.

empty.title: No scenarios yet
empty.description: Create the first training scenario: start with the basics, then add its stages.

noResults.title: No scenario matches these filters
noResults.description: Change the filters or clear them.

create.title: New scenario
create.description: Start with the basics. You add the stages on the next page, then preview the scenario and publish it.
create.ownerGlobalHint: All users of the platform. It uses a global protocol.
create.ownerInstitutionHint: Only the members of the institution. It can use a global protocol or one of the institution's own.
create.ownerFixed: The owner cannot be changed after the scenario is created.
create.slugHint: The scenario opens at <path>/simulations/{slug}</path>. Lowercase English letters, digits and hyphens. It cannot be changed later.
create.created: Draft created. Now add its stages.

fields.introHint: One or two sentences, shown on the catalogue card.
fields.settingHint: Where and when it happens, and the trainee's role.
fields.protocolHint: Options link to the steps of this protocol.
fields.feedbackHint: Why this option is right or wrong, with its source (WHO, CDC).
fields.criticalHint: Choosing this wrong option is an automatic high risk.
fields.stepHint: The step this choice follows or breaks. It drives the score.

editor.basicsDescription: What the trainee reads before the first stage.
editor.stagesDescription: The trainee answers the stages in this order, and each answer is final.
editor.removeStageDescription: Its question and options are removed when you save the scenario.
editor.noStages: No stages yet. Add the first stage of the situation.
editor.summaryOptions: {count, plural, =0 {No options} one {1 option} other {{n} options}}
editor.summaryCorrect: {count, plural, =0 {no correct option} one {1 correct} other {{n} correct}}
editor.maxStages: A scenario has at most {max} stages.
editor.maxOptions: A stage has at most {max} options.
editor.invalid: Some fields need attention. The first one is selected.
editor.protocolChanged: The protocol changed, so the step links of {count, plural, one {1 option} other {{n} options}} were cleared.
editor.liveWarning: This scenario is published: the changes you save are live for trainees at once.
editor.previewSaved: The preview plays the last saved version.
editor.protocolUnpublished: Its protocol is not published, so trainees cannot see this scenario even when it is published.

locked.title: Locked: trainees have attempted this version
locked.description: {count, plural, one {1 attempt uses} other {{n} attempts use}} this version. It is never edited in place, so every past result can still be explained. To change it, create a new version: you edit the copy and publish it, and this version is unpublished at the same time.
locked.draftExists: A draft of the next version already exists.

versions.title: Versions
versions.attempts: {count, plural, =0 {no attempts} one {1 attempt} other {{n} attempts}}

actions.publishDescription: Trainees who can see its protocol can play it at once.
actions.publishReplaces: {count, plural, one {Version {versions} is unpublished at the same time.} other {Versions {versions} are unpublished at the same time.}}
actions.publishAbandons: {count, plural, one {1 attempt still in progress on the old version is closed as unfinished; whoever comes back starts this version from the first stage.} other {{n} attempts still in progress on the old versions are closed as unfinished; whoever comes back starts this version from the first stage.}}
actions.unpublishDescription: It leaves the catalogue. Past results stay available.
actions.unpublishInProgress: {count, plural, one {1 attempt is in progress and cannot be finished while the scenario is unpublished.} other {{n} attempts are in progress and cannot be finished while the scenario is unpublished.}}
actions.deleteDescription: The draft and its stages are deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
actions.versionCreated: Version {n} created. Edit it, then publish it.
actions.versionExists: Version {n} is already a draft: it is open now.

issues.singleNeedsOneCorrect: A one-answer stage needs exactly one correct option.
issues.multiNeedsCorrect: Mark at least one option as correct.
issues.needsTwoOptions: A stage needs at least two options.
issues.criticalMustBeWrong: Only a wrong option can be a critical mistake.
issues.criticalNeedsStep: Link a critical mistake to the protocol step it breaks.
issues.stepNotInProtocol: Choose a step of this scenario's protocol.
issues.slugVersionSuffix: The address cannot end with a version number such as -v2 (reserved for versions).
issues.needsStage: Add at least one stage before publishing.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.forbidden: Only platform admins can change scenarios.
errors.stale: Someone else changed this scenario after you opened it. Reload the page to see the latest version (your changes are not saved).
errors.hasAttempts: A trainee has just started this scenario, so it is now locked. Reload the page and create a new version instead.
errors.slugTaken: Another scenario already uses this address.
errors.protocolNotAllowed: This protocol cannot be used for this owner.
errors.invalidContent: The saved content does not meet the rules. Open the editor and fix it first.
errors.cannotPublish: This scenario cannot be published yet.
errors.notDraft: Only an unpublished draft that nobody has attempted can be deleted.

preview.banner: Preview as a trainee: nothing you choose here is saved, and no attempt is recorded.
preview.unpublished: This scenario is not published: trainees cannot see it yet.
preview.resultDescription: This is what a trainee would see after these choices.
